edges: Josepha Petrick Kemarre began painting for Mbantua Gallery.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Josepha Petrick Kemarre's art struggled to survive the contraction of the primary art market in Australia since 2008.
Josepha Petrick Kemarre created the artwork 'Bush Berries' which portrays bush plum dreaming and women's ceremonies.
Josepha Petrick Kemarre was married to Robin Petyarre.
Josepha Petrick Kemarre's work was included in the National Gallery of Victoria's exhibitions.
